usage: The word 實驗室 (laboratory) is primarily used as a noun.
It commonly refers to a room or place where scientific experiments are conducted.
In sentences, it can appear as the object or location, e.g., 'I work in the laboratory.'
It can be combined with other words to specify types of laboratories, such as chemical laboratory or biology laboratory.
It is often used in academic, medical, and research contexts.
